name: observium
description: Observium is an autodiscovering network monitoring platform supporting a wide range of hardware platforms and operating systems. Directions: /config : this path is where Observium will store its PHP config file and the database which contains data for users, devices, and data. /opt/observium/logs : this path is where Observium will store its logs. /opt/observium/rrd : this path is where Observium will store its Round-Robin Database (RRD) data. /opt/observium/certificates : this path is where Observium will store its SSL/TLS certificates.
